The passage below outlines cell signalling.

Complete the passage by using the most appropriate scientific terms.

Cells need to interact with their environment and other cells around them. This is called cell signalling. Cells in mammals are involved in a complex system of communication with each other. For example, liver cells detect signals using receptors in their cell surface
